themes.title: Website Templates
themes.description: Complete, self-contained page scaffolds across eras and genres — modern SaaS, portfolio, blog, dashboard, e-commerce, plus Web 2.0 and 90s retro. Copy a whole page and reskin it.

themes.title: Combination Recipes
themes.description: Full UI blocks that compose multiple effects together — heroes, pricing cards, navbars, CTAs, and forms. Copy a whole section, not just one trick.

themes.title: Text Effects
themes.description: Typography treatments — glow, gradients, glitch, reveals, and animated lettering.

themes.title: Buttons
themes.description: Interactive button treatments — ripples, gradient borders, 3D presses, fills, and glows.

themes.title: Cards & Surfaces
themes.description: Card treatments — elevation, borders, gradients, media placement, and the hover states that make a card feel clickable.

themes.title: Backgrounds
themes.description: Full-surface treatments — animated gradients, aurora, mesh, noise, grids, and patterns.

themes.title: Badges & Tags
themes.description: Status pills, count badges, labels, and chips — the smallest components in a design system and the ones most often built inaccessibly.

themes.title: Avatars & Identity
themes.description: Representing people — avatars, initials, presence, groups, generated identicons, and fallback chains.

themes.title: Hover Interactions
themes.description: Pointer-driven micro-interactions — 3D tilt, magnetic pull, spotlight, image reveals, and card lifts.

themes.title: Micro-interactions
themes.description: Small state changes done well — toggles, checkmarks, likes, copy confirmations, and the tiny animations that make an interface feel responsive.

themes.title: Keyboard & Input
themes.description: Keyboard affordances — keycaps, shortcut hints, key-press feedback, focus order visualisation, and input method indicators.

themes.title: Forms & Inputs
themes.description: Accessible, styled form controls — floating labels, toggles, animated checkboxes, and custom sliders.

themes.title: Search UI
themes.description: Finding things — search bars, filter panels, result lists, facet counts, recent queries, and scoped search.

themes.title: Tooltips & Popovers
themes.description: Contextual overlays — hover hints, click popovers, coach marks, and the positioning and dismissal rules that make them usable.

themes.title: Modals & Overlays
themes.description: Dialogs, sheets, drawers, and lightboxes — entrance choreography plus the focus and dismissal behaviour that makes them safe to ship.

themes.title: Notifications & Toasts
themes.description: Transient and persistent messaging — toasts, banners, inline alerts, snackbars, and notification stacks.

themes.title: Loaders & Spinners
themes.description: Waiting states — spinners, dots, bars, skeleton placeholders, and progress indicators.

themes.title: Empty & Loading States
themes.description: The states between nothing and something — empty states, skeletons, error screens, offline notices, and first-run guidance.

themes.title: Progress & Meters
themes.description: Determinate progress: bars, rings, gauges, meters, and multi-segment indicators that show how much is done and how much is left.

themes.title: Charts & Data Viz
themes.description: Chart forms built from CSS and inline SVG — bars, lines, donuts, sparklines, and heatmaps, on a categorical palette validated for colour-vision deficiency.

themes.title: Tables & Data
themes.description: Data tables — sticky headers, sortable columns, zebra rows, inline editing, and dense layouts that stay readable.

themes.title: Timelines & Steppers
themes.description: Sequence components — vertical timelines, horizontal steppers, activity feeds, and branching histories.

themes.title: Transitions & Animations
themes.description: Motion primitives — entrance reveals, attention seekers, morphs, and looping ambient animations.

themes.title: 3D Transforms
themes.description: Perspective-driven effects — card flips, rotating cubes, and depth layering with transform-style: preserve-3d.

themes.title: Glass & Neumorphism
themes.description: Surface styling trends — frosted glassmorphism, soft neumorphic extrusions, and claymorphism.

themes.title: Borders & Shadows
themes.description: Edge and depth treatments — gradient borders, animated outlines, layered long shadows, and glows.

themes.title: Scroll Effects
themes.description: Scroll-driven behaviors — progress bars, parallax layers, sticky stacks, and snap.

themes.title: Images & Media
themes.description: Image treatments — duotone, filters, clip-path shapes, masks, and before/after reveals.

themes.title: SVG Effects
themes.description: Vector-graphics techniques — self-drawing line art, gooey filters, path morphing, turbulence distortion, text on a path, and grain.

themes.title: Masks & Clipping
themes.description: clip-path and mask-image techniques — geometric cut-outs, gradient fades, reveals, and compositing that keeps layout intact.

themes.title: Blends & Filters
themes.description: CSS filter and blend-mode recipes — duotones, colour grading, glows, and compositing tricks that need no image editor.

themes.title: Cursors & Pointers
themes.description: Custom cursor experiences — following dots, trailing rings, and reveal spotlights.

themes.title: Patterns & Textures
themes.description: Tileable surface patterns and material textures built entirely from CSS gradients — no image files, infinitely scalable, one element each.

themes.title: Dividers & Shapes
themes.description: Section separators and standalone shapes — wave dividers, angled cuts, arrows, ribbons, and decorative rules built from CSS and inline SVG.

themes.title: Navigation & Menus
themes.description: Nav affordances — animated underlines, morphing hamburger icons, and animated link lists.

themes.title: Retro Web
themes.description: Nostalgia from the 90s/2000s web — marquees, blink, starfields, visitor counters, and rainbow text. Modern, accessible reimplementations of deprecated tags.

themes.title: Neon & Cyberpunk
themes.description: Night-city aesthetics — neon tubes, holographic HUDs, scanning grids, and saturated glow on near-black surfaces.

themes.title: Vaporwave & Synthwave
themes.description: 80s-retrofuture aesthetics — chrome type, gradient sunsets, palm silhouettes, VHS artefacts, and grid horizons.

themes.title: Brutalism & Y2K
themes.description: Anti-design and turn-of-the-millennium web — raw borders, hard shadows, system type, bubble gradients, and gleeful excess.

themes.title: Holographic & Metallic
themes.description: Iridescent foils, chrome, gold, and oil-slick sheens — surfaces that shift colour with angle or motion.

themes.title: Nature & Organic
themes.description: Growth, foliage, water, and organic motion — soft curves and irregular timing that avoid the mechanical feel of geometric UI.

themes.title: Space & Cosmic
themes.description: Orbits, planets, starfields, nebulae, and black holes — cosmic motifs built with gradients, masks, and slow rotation.

themes.title: Weather & Ambient
themes.description: Weather states and ambient atmosphere — rain, snow, fog, lightning, sun, and wind, each self-contained and loopable.

themes.title: Fire & Water
themes.description: Elemental motion — flames, embers, smoke, liquid fills, waves, and bubbles, all in self-contained CSS.

themes.title: Glitch & Distortion
themes.description: Digital failure aesthetics — datamosh, tearing, pixel sorting, chroma split, and CRT artefacts.

themes.title: Paper & Print
themes.description: Print-inspired surfaces — paper stock, folds, stamps, tickets, receipts, torn edges, and risograph colour.

themes.title: Game UI
themes.description: Interface furniture from games — health bars, inventory slots, dialogue boxes, XP meters, minimaps, and achievement popups.

themes.title: Terminal & CLI
themes.description: Command-line aesthetics — prompts, ASCII output, progress spinners, log streams, and code windows.

themes.title: Audio & Music UI
themes.description: Player controls, waveforms, equalizers, vinyl, and volume — the interface vocabulary of audio applications.

themes.title: E-commerce UI
themes.description: Shopping interface parts — product cards, price displays, variant pickers, carts, reviews, and checkout summaries.

themes.title: Social UI
themes.description: Feed and community components — posts, comment threads, reactions, follow buttons, stories, and mentions.

themes.title: Calendar & Time
themes.description: Date and time interfaces — month grids, schedules, timers, timezone rows, and relative-time displays.

themes.title: Particles & Physics
themes.description: Motion with apparent physics — particle fields, gravity, springs, orbits, and collision-flavoured effects.

themes.title: Color Systems
themes.description: Design-choice references (beyond single effects) — palettes, gradient libraries, and semantic color tokens you can copy as CSS custom properties.

themes.title: Typography Systems
themes.description: Type-related design choices — modular scales, fluid type, and font pairings, as copy-ready references.

themes.title: Layout Archetypes
themes.description: Reusable page/section layout patterns — bento grids, holy grail, responsive card grids, and sticky sidebars.

themes.title: Motion Principles
themes.description: Motion-design references — easing curves and a duration scale, as copy-ready tokens for consistent animation.

themes.title: Accessibility Patterns
themes.description: Reference implementations of the accessibility primitives every interface needs — skip links, focus management, live regions, reduced motion, and forced colours.
